headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.17
summary: This release fixes the second 32-bit (armeabi-v7a) crash reported against v1.6.1-modder.16: libPlayFabMultiplayer.so no longer runs its static initializers in a standalone load before the game exists in the process, because the 32-bit load order now mirrors the proven 64-bit order with libminecraftpe.so first. Real-device testing on 32-bit phones still decides the next step, since the maintainer has no armeabi-v7a hardware.

items.text: 32-bit testers: if your phone is 32-bit-only (for example a POCO C3) and you have Minecraft 1.26.62.1 installed from Google Play, please try the armeabi-v7a APK from this release and report in the linked issue whether the game launches. The PlayFab crash you reported in #89 is fixed here, but your device confirms it.

Fixed 32-bit (armeabi-v7a) launches of Google Play installs crashing with a native SIGSEGV inside libPlayFabMultiplayer.so's static initializers on v1.6.1-modder.16: the previous fix's 32-bit load order ran the game's SDK libraries standalone before libminecraftpe.so, while the 64-bit path and the real game always initialize them inside libminecraftpe.so's own dependency graph via DT_NEEDED. The 32-bit order now mirrors the 64-bit one, with libminecraftpe.so loaded first (issue #89).
